serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Ah! {{punch}}
You: What just happened?!
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: It took you longer to wake up than I thought. You are such a lightweight. 
You: Ugh, I’m drenched in sweat and my hands are shaking…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: You love complaining, don’t you? 
Mrs. Fisher: So, what did you see?
You: What do you mean? I passed out, right?
Mrs. Fisher: You don’t remember, huh? It’s rare, but some have bad compatibility with it. 
You: I have no idea what you are talking about.
Mrs. Fisher: Whatever, just get up already and try casting your rod!
You: Alright, just give me a moment, I’m still dazed…
You: Here I go…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.NormalClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
You: …
You: It’s…{{wi}} worse than before…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: It seems like you failed.
You: Failed what?!
Mrs. Fisher: Right, you don’t remember. That would be annoying to explain…
You: Remember what?!
Mrs. Fisher: The vision! You saw something, or at least were supposed to see.
You: I didn’t have any visions. I was just drooling on the sand for like 5 hours!
Mrs. Fisher: Well, we will have to try again.
You: Again?! No way!
Mrs. Fisher: I thought you wanted to get better at fishing? Did you give up already? 
You: I didn’t… I just don’t think this whole fish joint stuff is very helpful. 
#mrsfisher.Eyes.NormalClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: You can think what you want. You know where to find me if you change your mind.
You: …
